subject: Bluewater observability activation — playbook, traces & alert routing
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cho <evan.cho@bluewater.io>, ops-lead@bluewater.io
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Bluewater observability activation — kickoff recap & immediate asks

Hi Evan / Bluewater ops team,

Thanks again for the kickoff today. Quick recap and a short list of actions so we can move into the hands-on activation window this week: 

Summary of decisions from the call:
- Redwood will own initial dashboard templates and a tracing hook set targeted at your payment processing service (payments-api).
- Bluewater will provide a dev/stage service account (k8s role + API key) and a sample traffic trace for the first 72h profile.
- Alert routing: primary PagerDuty for SRE, email to product-oncall for severity-2. We agreed to a short first-week burn-in with conservative thresholds.

Immediate asks (can you confirm by EOD?):
1) Dev/stage credentials: k8s service account name + kubeconfig or role binding details.
2) Example trace or representative request id: a 5–10 minute span that includes retries and downstream latencies.
3) Current alerting playbook link (if you have an existing runbook PDF).

Attachments: initial runbook draft, dashboard view list, trace hook snippets. These are raw — we'll iterate.

Next steps: our team will stage the dashboard and push the trace hook snippets to your dev environment on Thursday (2029-11-04). If anything slips, ping me directly.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: bluewater-observability-runbook-v0.3.md)
From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@bluewater.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-lead@bluewater.io, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-11-02T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Bluewater observability activation — kickoff recap & immediate asks

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the asks and timelines:

1) We'll create the dev service account today and send kubeconfig to Laura and Ben (expect by 17:00 PST).
2) Attached is a trace export (sample-request-id: bw-req-3312) from staging that shows the retry path you saw.
3) Runbook: we have an older oncall-runbook.pdf in our Confluence; sending a link below.

One note on alerting: our product team wants the first-week thresholds to be very sensitive — they'd rather false positives early than missed regressions. We can relax after the initial ramp.

Link: https://confluence.bluewater.io/display/OPS/Runbook

Evan
Director, Platform Engineering
Bluewater Labs
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cho <evan.cho@bluewater.io>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-11-03T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Bluewater observability activation — kickoff recap & immediate asks

Thanks, Evan — noted on the sensitive-first-week approach. A couple of operational clarifications from our side before we push artifacts: 

- Dashboard scopes: we'll create three focused views (ingestion latency, tail-latency by downstream, error taxonomy summary by service). The attached spreadsheet lists the tile names and the recommended queries.
- Runbook layout: I've attached v0.3 which includes sections for escalation contacts, triage checklist, and SLA sweet spots. Please review the "Triage Checklist" table on page 2 — confirm the expected owner for each bullet (SRE vs Product vs Infra).
- Access: Ben, can you confirm we have RBAC for a read-only monitoring service account in Bluewater's staging cluster? If not, we'll need that before Thursday.

Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
(attachment: dash-views-bluewater.xlsx)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@bluewater.io>
Date: 2029-11-03T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Bluewater observability activation — tracing hook notes + sampling suggestion

Adding a short technical note from the infra side: 

1) Trace hooks: the snippet set uses a lightweight header-based correlation (X-Req-Id) and a 1% adaptive tail-sampling policy by default. For payments-api we'll bump to 5% for the first 48 hours to capture more edge cases (retries, db hotspots). See attached patch for the instrumentation changes.
2) Error taxonomy: recommend we map 3 buckets — user errors (4xx), transient infra (5xx-retryable), and permanent infra (5xx-non-retryable). We'll add a dashboard tile that groups errors by bucket and shows the top 10 endpoints.
3) Alert routing: I'll wire critical alerts to your PagerDuty integration and set the escalation to include Product on-call for severity-1 within 15 minutes.

If Bluewater wants to keep sensitivity high, we should also attach a short 'false-positive review' cadence — quick 10m standup each morning for the first 5 days.

- Ben
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: trace-hook-snippets.patch)
From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@bluewater.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-11-04T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Bluewater observability activation — playbook, traces & alert routing

All good from our side. Confirmed we've: 
- Created dev service account (kubeconfig sent to Laura).
- Shared the staging trace (bw-req-3312) in Slack channel #bluewater-observability.
- Reviewed the runbook v0.3; Product confirmed SRE will own initial triage items.

Greenlight to proceed with the higher sampling for 48h and the dashboard staging on Thursday. We'll run the morning 10m false-positive review standups and iterate thresholds. Confirm PTO for me on Friday afternoon — Ben/Laura/Alex please own the morning sync if anything comes up.

Thanks — looking forward to the activation.

Evan

Notes: small follow-ups expected — Laura to update triage ownership in runbook; Alex to schedule Thursday deployment window (11/07 09:00–11:00 PST); Ben to open PagerDuty integration ticket and post integration ID in Drive.
